Container.Name: model-workshop-manager
Container.Overview:
Model Workshop Manager keeps your scale-model hobby in one place: a searchable catalog of kits and paints kept separate from what you actually own, barcode scanning to check whether you already have a kit, a one-click starter catalog of 10,000+ paints from 30+ brands (Tamiya, Vallejo, Citadel, Mr. Hobby, AK and more), builds with progress photos and "required vs. owned" paint matching, a shopping list and wishlist, supplies with low-stock alerts, CSV/JSON import and export, and in-app backups. Installable as a PWA on phone and desktop.
Single-user and private by default: one SQLite file and your photos on your own disk, no accounts, no cloud, no tracking.
First run: open the WebUI and create your username and password on the one-time setup screen. Nothing else needs configuring.
Meant for your LAN or a VPN, not the open internet. If you put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE to true and TRUST_PROXY to 1.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. The app listens on 3000 inside the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded photos and the auto-generated session secret.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where in-app backups are written and restored from. Point it at a share you already back up.

Config.Name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true only once the app is served over HTTPS (e.g. behind a reverse proxy with TLS). Over plain HTTP, true makes the browser drop the login cookie and login silently fails.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the app (usually 1 for SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager or Traefik) so the login rate limiter sees real client IPs. Leave empty without a proxy. 'true' is refused on purpose and the app won't start.
